by: session, Adrian 16 Oct 2026: 'put each common mistake at the end of its clip as a Watch out step'

beats.say: A dishwasher is sixty-two decibels and a pump is fifty. Subtract the two readings to compare them.
Minus Power turns the right side into one log of the ratio. The K cancels.
asks: What is the Minus Power law?

beats.say: Divide both sides by ten. Log of the ratio is one point two.
Log is base ten, so un-log with ten to the power. The ratio is ten to the power one point two.
Ten to the power one point two is about fifteen point eight.
asks: How do I key this in?

beats.say: So the dishwasher is about fifteen point eight times as intense as the pump.
Watch out: the answer is not twelve. Twelve is the difference in decibels, not how many times.

do.text: ✗ Watch out: not $12$: that is the dB difference
